Diagnosis.submission: The CoreDNS ConfigMap has been misconfigured with a malicious template plugin that returns NXDOMAIN for all DNS queries matching *.svc.cluster.local. This prevents all Kubernetes services from being resolved by name within the cluster. The template block `template ANY ANY svc.cluster.local { match ".*\.svc\.cluster\.local\.?$" rcode NXDOMAIN }` was added before the kubernetes plugin in the Corefile, causing every service lookup to fail with Host not found errors. This breaks all inter-service communication in the social-network application, including nginx-thrift failing to reach user-timeline-service and home-timeline-service, compose-post-service failing to reach user-service, and home-timeline-service failing to reach post-storage-service.
